parent_objective: design source-balanced boundary mining from M728 action-critical rows

public_gates: M730 starts from M728 source-balanced action-critical rows
M730 defines boundary perturbations without actor input changes
M730 keeps normal-history retention sentinel and source-balance checks
M730 separates action-critical and outcome-critical claims
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use the singleton M728 outcome row as a sufficient corpus
do not export action-only rows as outcome-positive proof
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_action_to_outcome: convert source-balanced action rows into outcome rows
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a no-training boundary miner using M728 action-critical rows as source pool
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new data wave result and no checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot preserve normal-history retention
stop if sentinel false positives are not part of the gate
stop if action-only and outcome-positive rows are mixed
stop if the design admits actor update PPO or promotion
fallback_plan: if boundary mining remains outcome-negative, design sequence-level interventions
if boundary mining exposes model-fidelity limits, design asymmetric/yaw-disturbance dynamics
if source concentration reappears, repair source selection before objective work
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M729 promotes from source-balanced temporal wave to boundary outcome mining

hypothesis: M728 action-critical rows may become outcome-critical if evaluated near local obstacle and terminal-margin boundaries under source-balanced selection.
success_criteria: M730 defines the M728 action-critical source pool
M730 defines local boundary perturbation axes
M730 defines normal-retention sentinel and outcome gates
M730 blocks source export actor update PPO and promotion
M730 admits only a no-training M731 implementation
failure_criteria: design treats action rows as outcome proof
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M730 may only design a no-training M731 boundary miner. It must not admit source export objective design actor update PPO or promotion until M731 is run and audited.
